title: 目が 1 mm 長いだけで、遠くがぼける。目のなかの光を1本ずつ計算 #Shorts
description:
光が角膜と水晶体で曲がり、網膜に像を結ぶまでを、本物の目の寸法の模型で光線を1本ずつ計算。ピントやひとみが追いつくまでの時間、暗さに慣れていく時間、老眼・近視・乱視とメガネも、測られた値で。ブラウザのアプリ「目のなかの光の道」から。

アプリ: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/eye-optics/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

おもな出どころ:
Navarro R, Santamaría J, Bescós J (1985) Accommodation-dependent model of the human eye with aspherics. JOSA A 2(8):1273–1281（目の寸法・屈折率・調節の式）
Bharadwaj SR, Schor CM (2006) Vision Research 46:1019–1037（ピント合わせの遅れと速さ）
Mathôt S (2018) Pupillometry. Journal of Cognition 1(1):16（ひとみの遅れと速さ）
Patryas L ほか (2013) Graefe's Archive 251:1821–1827、Lamb TD, Pugh EN (2004) Progress in Retinal and Eye Research 23:307–380（暗さに慣れる時間）
Curcio CA ほか (1990) J Comp Neurol 292:497–523（中心窩の桿体のない所）
Zaidi Q ほか (2012) Current Biology 22:220–224（残像は網膜の神経節細胞の順応）
ひとみの開く速さ・残像の強さなどの一部は、測られた値をもとにした推定です。

音楽: プログラムで合成したオリジナルの音です。

#目 #光 #近視 #まなびラボ

en.title: Just 1 mm Too Long, and Far Things Blur: Tracing Light Inside the Eye #Shorts
en.description:
From "Light’s Path Inside the Eye", a browser app. Follow light as the cornea and lens bend it into an image on the retina, ray by ray, with a model of a real eye's sizes. See how long focusing and the pupil take to catch up, how the eye gets used to the dark, and presbyopia, nearsightedness, astigmatism and glasses, all from measured values.

App (switch the app to English with the EN button): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/eye-optics/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

Main sources:
Navarro R, Santamaría J, Bescós J (1985) Accommodation-dependent model of the human eye with aspherics. JOSA A 2(8):1273–1281 (eye sizes, refractive indices, accommodation)
Bharadwaj SR, Schor CM (2006) Vision Research 46:1019–1037 (delay and speed of focusing)
Mathôt S (2018) Pupillometry. Journal of Cognition 1(1):16 (pupil delay and speed)
Patryas L et al. (2013) Graefe's Archive 251:1821–1827; Lamb TD, Pugh EN (2004) Progress in Retinal and Eye Research 23:307–380 (dark adaptation)
Curcio CA et al. (1990) J Comp Neurol 292:497–523 (the rod-free fovea)
Zaidi Q et al. (2012) Current Biology 22:220–224 (afterimages come from adaptation of retinal ganglion cells)
Some values, such as how fast the pupil opens and how strong afterimages are, are estimates based on measurements.

Music: original sounds synthesized by code.

#Eye #Optics #Biology
